metrics.label: Max Drawdown
metrics.description: Maximum portfolio loss from peak to trough over the 3-month test window. The dominant failure mode when a compromised skill issues outsized orders.

metrics.label: Tail Risk
metrics.description: Expected loss in the worst 1% of outcomes (Conditional Value-at-Risk, 99th percentile). Bounds the damage when rare, severe adversarial inputs reach execution.

metrics.label: Delegation Gap
metrics.description: Deviation between the written execution policy and what actually happened. Near-zero means the harness closed almost all drift between intent and execution.

metrics.label: Attack Success
metrics.description: Fraction of crafted adversarial inputs that caused the agent to execute outside its policy. Residual 72.8% indicates remaining model-layer exposure — zero false blocks (no legitimate trades blocked).

controls.label: Exposure Budget
controls.desc: Projection-based position-size limits block any single skill from deploying more than the permitted capital fraction, regardless of what the model requested.

controls.label: Cooldown + Order-Rate
controls.desc: Per-window rate limits prevent a compromised skill from flooding the exchange with cascading orders in the same slot.

controls.label: Slippage Bounds
controls.desc: Hard slippage ceilings catch adversarially inflated price estimates before they drain the vault in a single trade.

controls.label: Staged Execution
controls.desc: Large positions are broken into smaller tranches so per-error loss is bounded even when an order is wrong.

controls.label: Tool + Venue Allowlist
controls.desc: Only pre-approved tools and exchange venues are reachable from inside the execution contract; new skills cannot route to arbitrary endpoints.

testWindow: Binance USD-M BTCUSDT / ETHUSDT perpetuals, 2025-09-01 to 2025-12-01 (15-min bars)
